reference.title: To sort and group List Ranges

ol.li: From the Display Map panel, click on the Type picklist and select "List."
(Optional) Type a description in the Header field to display above the label row of the list range.
For Sort by field 1 and Sort by field 2, select an individual column to sort by. Choose whether records will be sorted in Ascending or Descending order.

li.p: For Group by field 1 and Group by field 2, select a column in the repeating range to group by.

note.p: Fields you intend to Group by should be mapped at the leftmost side of the List Range when you create a Display Map.

ol.li: Danny decides that the Display Map he created (see Working with Display Maps) needs some grouping and sorting options. He clicks on Display Map, selects the "Pipeline Main" map and clicks Edit.
From the Display Map panel, Danny clicks on the Type picklist and selects "List."

li.p: He clicks on the Options tab in the Display Map panel and selects the following options:Objects: Account.OpportunityLayout: VerticalSort by field 1: Account.Opportunity.NameGroup by field 1: Account.Opportunity.Owner (Name)Group by field 2: Account.Opportunity.Account (Name)
To improve the appearance of the app, Danny removes the bracketed text from each cell in row 4, removes the gridlines and adds some color to the app.

ol.li: He clicks Save on the Display Map and Close.
Danny clicks Save App to save all changes to the app.

section.title: Result
section.p: Grouping and Sorting support for numbers, decimals and currency
Support is included for both single and two levels of grouping in Display Maps:

ul.li: You can total all numbers, decimals and currency fields
You can create totals on all Formula fields. Totals are displayed for formula fields having datatype as number, decimal and currency.
